steps.name: Step 1 — Open an existing pipeline; it loads in the editor
Step 2 — Expand "Information" section in left panel
Step 3 — Verify "Pipeline ID:" is shown with a numeric Copy ID button
Step 4 — Verify "Version ID:" is shown with a numeric Copy version ID button
Step 5 — Verify "Trigger:" shows the trigger type ("Chat Message")
Step 7 — Click "Copy ID"; verify toast feedback and clipboard content
Step 8 — Click "Copy version ID"; verify toast feedback and clipboard content
Step 9 — Click "Show" link; verify it opens the pipeline's visual (Mermaid) representation
